description: Live web SPA Command Portal (GET /webhook/crm/portal) and authenticated JSON CRM mutation APIs (/webhook/crm/api/*) wired to all 4 Data Tables and Google Sheets.

nodeGroups.name: 1. Hydrate Portal & Overview API
nodeGroups.description: Reads all 4 CRM Data Tables to render the SSR HTML Admin Command Portal or authenticated JSON overview.

nodeGroups.name: 2. Convert Lead Action API
nodeGroups.description: Promotes qualified CRM leads to active customers across Data Tables, Google Sheets, and Activity Log.

nodeGroups.name: 3. Resolve Ticket Action API
nodeGroups.description: Resolves support tickets, decrements customer open ticket counters, and syncs Sheets & Activity Log.
